comment: Core speed budgets (docs/architecture/m3-build-spec.md section 8). Read by tools/perf_core.gd, nightly in CI. Never read by a GUT test. A row past its limit fails the job. Times are CPU milliseconds, headless; save_mb is the size of the .sav file.

season_ms.what: the three phases of Season.run, worst of 8 seasons

works_phase_ms.what: the works phase with 600 works, worst

stats_phase_ms.what: the stats phase (1 ms a country), worst

save_ms.what: SaveFile.write (bytes, zstd, sha, the file sequence)

load_ms.what: SaveFile.read, Snapshot.restore with WorldImprove.over, the digest check

summary_ms.what: SeasonSummary.of for the largest country, uncached

work_check_ms.what: one Works.build_check with 600 works under way (the pending scan)
